item.goal: Fix createFakeFetch in frontend/src/lib/api/fake.ts: a handler result is a {status, body} wrapper only when it is a plain object whose own keys are all status or body (at least one of them). Any other object, such as a Report {id, period, body}, is the response body as a whole with status 200. Existing wrappers keep working (signup 201 with a body, logout 204 with no body). The frontend must still type-check: `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` in frontend/ passes (r may be undefined).
